# Explicit-width content-fitted AutoFit grid

These are generated public documents, round-tripped through Word so tblGrid contains Word's saved content-fitted widths while tcW retains its older preferences. No customer document, image or text is included. Local-author metadata is replaced with Public fixture; normalized reference PDFs retain byte-identical RGB rasters at 150 DPI.

The primary control has an asymmetric explicit-width AutoFit table, a nested table in its first column, and an indented recipient word that no longer fits its preferred tcW. Re-expanding/rescaling stale preferences shifts the recipient left. Preserving the saved content-fitted grid changes ink F1 from 91.5349% to 100%.

Four companion controls remain byte-identical: short content with valid preferences, an automatic-width table, fixed layout, and no nested table. Existing discrepancies in a negative control are not claimed to be fixed by this patch.
